voxy.config.title: Voxy
voxy.config.general.enabled.tooltip: Completely hoists or strikes the Voxy mod altogether, matey
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: How many hands on deck the ServiceThreadPool can order around at once
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Steals the Sodium builder hands to work in Voxy's crew pool. Keeps the ship from shudderin' and laggin' when sailin' fast with the spyglass set to a grand distance
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Allows Voxy to plunder newly sighted chunks and chart 'em into distant horizons (LoDs)
voxy.config.general.rendering.tooltip: Enables or douses Voxy's visual wizardry
voxy.config.general.subDivisionSize.tool: The grandest size in squared pixels on the canvas before choppin' 'em down into finer details. Smaller means a finer prize for the eyes, yarrr!
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: How many leagues of chunks Voxy can spy on the horizon
voxy.config.general.environmental_fog.to: Enables or banishes the thick environmental sea fog from Voxy's view
voxy.config.general.ssao_mode.tooltip: The manner of plottin' dark shadows in the nooks and crannies. (Auto tries to plunder the finest look without sinkin' your ship's speed!)
